note: Single source of truth for reviewed upstream Strata serve/server.py sources. Hashes are SHA-256 of the file with CRLF normalized to LF (legacy CRLF-byte hashes kept for 0.1.41). A reviewed hash is only a fast path: unknown sources are analysed structurally at import time (strata_observer.analyze_source) and observed or degraded per capability. mcpPySha256 lists reviewed serve/mcp.py sources for the Linux MCP stdio guard (strata_mcp_guard), which applies the same reviewed-or-structural rule.

reviewed.review: Public run delegates to _run under a keep-awake finally block; event/done, request_stats and handler boundaries intact.
Non-finite retry/error and native slot timings; single-request accounting and admission release preserved.
Optional _json headers, retryable 503s, preparation disconnects, native timings and FIFO release.
Engine crash classification and Responses reasoning_effort only; full MockEngine HTTP contract suite passes unchanged.

Handler._json gains retry_after=None (429/503 Retry-After); the observer forwards it only when supplied. Service.run/_run/_note/begin_request, do_POST/_post, send_response/_note/_capture and the four inference routes unchanged; /v1/images/generations and the /v1/v1 alias are admitted (maintenance drain) but not counted as inference. Same source as the control package the official App ships. Full MockEngine HTTP suite (36 tests, no skips) passes; needs jinja2+regex. mcp.py: StdioTransport.start spawns via serve.lifeline.popen instead of Popen+contain; the Linux guard replaces start (same cfg keys and attributes), so containment is unchanged.
